fusions.name: Head of the Wedge
fusions.desc: Breaks the air ahead of you with a bolt that deals 26 damage to the first enemy it meets and ignores its resistance.

fusions.name: Wing-Flicked Spray
fusions.desc: Flicks spray in a cone 2.5 tiles long that deals 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave each target [Soaked] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Off the Back
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Paddling Calm

riders.text: you skim over it faster than over ground
and nothing that has to wade can reach you

fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. From bronze rank you move 10% faster over it, from silver your stamina recovers 15% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 8%.
